title: Mario's glove seen on the shiny floor of the craft
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was lying down somewhere and there was a glove on a floor, a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck.
Then he said something that shocked me: He said he saw my mittens on the floor, next to where he was lying down, as he was hearing the voices.

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force security sergeant who was Mario Woods's partner on the 1977 night the two men say they were taken aboard a craft at a South Dakota missile field, tells Michels he remembers lying somewhere and seeing a glove on "a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck." The detail matters because it would place both men in the same strange room. Woods's own 2017 account, written for the researcher Robert Hastings, says Johnson once told him the same thing: "he saw my mittens on the floor, next to where he was lying down, as he was hearing the voices."
